{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Data shape:", penguins.shape)
print("Columns:", penguins.columns.tolist())
print("Missing values:")
print(penguins.isnull().sum())
print("Data types:")
print(penguins.dtypes)

# Check for duplicates
print("Number of duplicate rows:", penguins.duplicated().sum())

# Check for sentinel values or implausible data
print("Summary statistics for flipper_length_mm:")
print(penguins['flipper_length_mm'].describe())
print("Summary statistics for body_mass_g:")
print(penguins['body_mass_g'].describe())"}
